$comment: AI FIRST PASS. Every verdict here is a RECOMMENDATION carrying its evidence and its cannot-verify list. Nothing here approves anything: aiReview counts toward no gate, satisfies no provenance and lets nothing ship. Set humanVerdict on a row to record your decision.

boundary.why: This repo's entire trust model is that AI never affirms its own work. tcapFormat has no automatic path to true. review-provenance refuses to let authored content be silently settled. historianReview exists because a rationale explaining a misconception is still a claim about history. An AI reviewer that writes approvals would satisfy the queue and destroy the reason a district could trust the bank — and it would do it invisibly, because an approval record looks the same whoever wrote it.
boundary.clearanceMeaning: An aiReview verdict is a RECOMMENDATION with its evidence attached. It never counts toward Grade A, never satisfies review-provenance, and never lets an item ship.
